messages:
deploy-bot: publish blocked for repo=redwood/services/ingest tag=2026-03-21-rc3
deploy-bot: reason=manifest-list platform order mismatch; registry shows [arm64, amd64] but manifest expected [amd64, arm64] -> reject to avoid ambiguous pull behavior
rachel_rm: saw the reject during the release window, can we still promote current canary?
sam_oncall: deploybot refused promote at 1719201190. Canary is stuck in staging.
meena_ci: I pushed a change last night that sorts platform entries by build completion time, that probably flipped the order. I can roll that back but it'll take a few mins.
liam_sre: do we have customers on canary that need continuity? aisha?
aisha_prod: two enterprise orgs are on the canary. Avoid aborting the window if possible. Manual pin to the last known-good digest seems safest.
jonah_devex: options: 1) manual promote to previous digest, 2) retag and republish corrected manifestlist, 3) abort window and revert changes. Manual promote is quickest.
rachel_rm: agree. Sam, can you run a manual promote and add an exception note? Also log the issue for republishing post-window.
sam_oncall: will do. Confirming digest: last successful image digest sha256:8a3f2b9e4f6c7d1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8901234567890abcdef1234567890fedcba. Promote command: `/deploybot promote redwood/services/ingest@sha256:8a3f2b9e4f6c7d1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8901234567890abcdef1234567890fedcba --to=prod --note="pin to last-good due to manifest order mismatch"`
meena_ci: I'll also schedule a republish job that constructs the manifestlist with deterministic platform ordering and push to staging after the window. Holding it until we confirm.
liam_sre: create an exception ticket so deploybot won't auto-fail the manual promote and so audit logs capture the rationale.
jonah_devex: I'll create a PR to add a buildkite preflight check that enforces stable platform ordering (buildkite/checks#785).
aisha_prod: I'll update release notes to say we pinned to the previous digest and will republish a corrected manifest post-window; include exception ticket id.
rachel_rm: action items: Sam - manual promote, Liam - exception ticket, Meena - republish job queued, Jonah - preflight PR, Aisha - release notes. React with :thumbsup: when done.
sam_oncall: promoted to prod, note added, and deploybot audit shows manual promote at 1719201250.
liam_sre: created exception INFRA-1629 and linked to this thread.
meena_ci: republish job queued as job/4527 targeting staging, gated until window close.
jonah_devex: PR opened: buildkite/checks#785 1 - adds manifest-order lint step to multi-arch pipeline.
aisha_prod: release notes updated and published to the docs site with INFRA-1629 reference.
rachel_rm: thanks team. We'll run a short postmortem later to decide if buildkite should enforce stable ordering by default. For now marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
